what: Cards or backplates are tied to scroll and tilt as they rise — ”to” tilts as it passes (back lime plane 4°·−10px), ”from” rises from below, more tilted, and settles at its own angle (next case card −12°·30%)

options.origin: Tilt axis (transform-origin), default is the element center — the Brand letter collage uses ”100% 50%” (right end)
options.scrub: Scroll-follow lag (seconds) or true (sticks instantly), default .5
options.rx: Tilt back and forth (rotateX, degrees) — a laptop whose screen lies back then stands up (Brand -19)
options.persp: Tilt perspective (px, transformPerspective) — use together with rx
options.ease: Curve, default from is power2.out · to is none
